xlsx_no_base.title: This workbook has no comparison data
xlsx_no_base.detail: The hidden comparison sheet is missing or damaged (another program re-saved the workbook, or it was made by hand). Every differing cell replaces the model value; model edits made since the export cannot be detected. Rows missing from the workbook are not deleted.
xlsx_no_base.confirm: I checked the changes: replace the model values ({n})
xlsx_no_base.confirm_first: Confirm the import of a workbook without comparison data first
